replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Not at all. My low neuroticism and high agreeableness help me stay calm. Math is a joy, not a source of stress. Even complex problems excite me.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used AI to practice problems. It was helpful for quick feedback, but I prefer traditional methods for deep understanding. My high conscientiousness makes me value thorough learning.
